initial_application: Jira records svn revision 12747. The matching git-svn commit 5557727253b532ee80752365259b8a112524f386 changed the old ValueSet spreadsheet validate-code description from identifier/valueset to constraint/valueset, which appears to be an incomplete or erroneous first application. A later ValueSet documentation update in d90f55e1cbc897c77c5188342e1d43353f38f2c3 changed the wording to url, context or valueSet.
additional_context: The active current source is source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml, referenced by the active ValueSet operations list, with ValueSet and OperationDefinition active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-14355, already represented on the combined branch, covers the later correction from constraint/valueset to context/valueSet; later $validate-code changes such as FHIR-33941 and FHIR-41431 preserved the corrected value set selector names.
